newsitem.title: USA: C.P. Clare starts job cuts at Belgian facility.
newsitem.headline: C.P. Clare starts job cuts at Belgian facility.

text.p: C.P. Clare Corp said Tuesday it began cutting jobs at its Belgian wetted reed facility as part of its worldwide restructuring.
The company did not say how many jobs at the Belgian facility it cut, or how many would be cut, as part of the restructuring.
On September 17, the company said it would take a $14.75 million charge for the restructuring.
The company said Tuesday that after the restructuring, the Belgian plant will still make wetted reed switches and oversee the company's European sales, marketing and distribution operations.
The company added that it needed to restructure "to meet the changing demands of the international market for mercury-based wetted reed relays.''
